Container.Name: bazarr-plus
Container.Overview: Bazarr+ manages subtitles for movies, TV, and sports. Start with a fresh config, then connect your libraries. Media folders and translation companions are optional. This is the LavX fork, separate from upstream Bazarr. Before migrating, stop upstream Bazarr and back up its config. Never run both against the same config directory.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Choose another host port if upstream Bazarr already uses 6767.

Config.Name: Config directory
Config.Description: Persistent settings, database, and plugins. Use a separate folder for a fresh installation.

Config.Name: User ID
Config.Description: Unraid nobody defaults to 99. This user must be able to write subtitles beside your media.

Config.Name: Group ID
Config.Description: Unraid users defaults to 100. Match the group that can access your media.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Use an IANA time zone such as Europe/Budapest.
